draft.name: OCBC Titanium Rewards
draft.notes: Card has been rebranded to 'OCBC Rewards Card' as of early 2024; the Titanium Rewards branding is legacy. Rewards are awarded in blocks of S$5 per transaction. Base rate is 1 OCBC$ (0.4 mpd) on all spend. Bonus of 10 OCBC$ per S$1 (4 mpd total) applies to selected retail MCCs (clothing, bags, shoes, department stores, electronics, online shopping) both locally and overseas. Monthly bonus cap is 10,000 OCBC$ (~S$1,111 eligible spend). A boosted promotional rate of 15 OCBC$/6 mpd applies to Watsons and select online platforms (Lazada, Shopee, Taobao, TikTok Shop) until 31 Dec 2025, with the same 10,000 OCBC$ monthly bonus cap. KrisFlyer conversion: 25,000 OCBC$ = 10,000 KrisFlyer miles at a S$25 flat fee. No transfer fee for the 8 newer partner programmes. Transfer fee of S$25 applies per KrisFlyer conversion regardless of block size — best to convert in large amounts to dilute cost.

earningRates.description: 10 OCBC$ (4 mpd) on selected retail MCCs — clothing, shoes, bags, department stores, electronics, online shopping — in Singapore. Capped at 10,000 bonus OCBC$ per month (~S$1,111 spend).
10 OCBC$ (4 mpd) on selected retail MCCs overseas (same MCC whitelist as local). Bonus cap shared with local: 10,000 bonus OCBC$ per month.
Base rate: 1 OCBC$ (0.4 mpd) on all other local SGD spend including transport, dining, groceries, petrol, travel, etc. No cap.
Base rate: 1 OCBC$ (0.4 mpd) on all other foreign currency spend not falling under bonus MCCs. No cap.
PROMOTIONAL (until 31 Dec 2025): 15 OCBC$ (6 mpd) at Watsons and online platforms Lazada, Shopee, Taobao, TikTok Shop. Shared 10,000 bonus OCBC$ monthly cap (~S$667 at this rate).

warnings: Card has been rebranded from 'OCBC Titanium Rewards' to 'OCBC Rewards Card' as of early 2024. The product still exists but the Titanium name is discontinued.
The 6 mpd (15 OCBC$) rate at Watsons and select online platforms is promotional until 31 Dec 2025; the evergreen bonus rate is 4 mpd (10 OCBC$).
The 10,000 bonus OCBC$ monthly cap is shared across all bonus-earning transactions. At 4 mpd this caps at ~S$1,111 spend; at 6 mpd it caps at ~S$667.
KrisFlyer transfer fee is S$25 flat per conversion (no fee for 8 newer partners added Jul 2023). Conversion must be in multiples of 25,000 OCBC$ for KrisFlyer.
OCBC$ conversion to KrisFlyer: 25,000 OCBC$ = 10,000 miles (effective 0.4 miles per OCBC$). Transfer rates to other partners vary and are generally less favourable.
Bonus OCBC$ eligibility is MCC-based (merchant category code), not purely online/offline. Some merchants may not qualify even if they appear to be retail/shopping.
No foreign transaction fee advantage — pairing with Amaze card works for MCC-based bonuses but NOT for merchant-name-based bonuses (e.g. AliExpress).
